FN-6Y57P33-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 166
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 166 as introduced would revise the distribution of the existing additional $50
penalty for driving with a canceled, denied, suspended, or revoked license as provided below
for, which would reduce potential receipts to the Traffic Safety Trust Fund and the Peace
Officers' Standards and Training Fund, respectively, and would corresponding increase receipts
by the estimated amounts shown below.
Fund/Entity Current This Bill Change in
Law Receipts
Traffic Safety Trust Fund 50% 33.33% -$52,693
Peace Officers' Standards and Training Fund 50% 33.33% -$52,693
Local law enforcement agency that issued the citation - 33.33% $105,386
In addition, this bill would require the payment of all reasonable and customary towing and
storage fees, as well as all administrative costs, associated with the impoundment of the vehicle.
